name: Samesurf
description_en: Samesurf supports shared browsing sessions in which participants view web content and pass in-page control. It also offers uploads, messaging, audio/video and a separate desktop screen-sharing mode. Standalone dashboard use and integrated Enterprise deployments have different entitlements, configuration work and costs.
description_zh: Samesurf 支持共享浏览会话，让参与者查看网页内容并传递页面内控制权；还提供上传、消息、音视频及独立的桌面屏幕共享模式。独立仪表盘使用与集成式 Enterprise 部署的权限、配置工作和费用不同。

core_features.name_zh: 通过邀请加入共享会话

core_features.explanation_en: Enterprise integration offers chat, hotkey or button escalation into a shared experience.
core_features.explanation_zh: Enterprise 集成提供聊天、快捷键或按钮触发共享体验。

en: Evaluate a synthetic support order page with invited participants, explicit leader handoff and a disconnected-session status check.

sections.title_en: Choose the shared content boundary before the session
sections.title_zh: 会话开始前选定共享内容边界
sections.en:
In a proposed support demonstration, a customer and agent inspect a synthetic order-status page together. Samesurf’s cobrowse mode shares web content and permits in-page control handoff. That differs from its screen-sharing mode, which displays desktop content and may include an entire screen or selected window. A participant viewing the session is not automatically granted control of the whole device.

For a PDF or presentation, the guide offers Upload & Share through the cloud. Choose deliberately between uploading a copy, showing desktop content and co-browsing the live page. The appropriate boundary depends on what needs to be seen and changed. No customer account, order, payment or document was used; this is an evaluation example rather than a completed support outcome.
sections.zh:
在假设支持演示中，客户与客服共同查看虚构订单状态页。Samesurf 的协同浏览模式共享网页内容，并允许传递页面内控制权；屏幕共享则展示桌面内容，可能包括整个屏幕或所选窗口。观看会话不自动授予整个设备的控制权。

对于 PDF 或演示文稿，指南提供经云端 Upload & Share。应明确选择上传副本、展示桌面内容，还是协同浏览实时页面；适当边界取决于需要看什么、改什么。本研究未使用客户账户、订单、付款或文档；这是评估示例，不是已完成的支持成果。

sections.title_en: Join the intended room and make control changes explicit
sections.title_zh: 加入目标房间，明确每次控制权变更
sections.en:
The quick guide describes a host signing in to the dashboard, starting immediately or scheduling a session, then distributing an invitation link or room number. Its active-room queue is a support-entry pattern, not evidence that every Pro customer receives a configured website queue. Test the intended entry route before giving it to customers.

The FAQ separates requesting control, the leader granting or denying it, and the host taking it back. Cursor tracking and follower scrolling supply visual context; they do not constitute consent to act on someone’s account. For the order example, identify who may navigate and who may submit changes, then verify the handoff with disposable data. A guest’s ability to enter through a link does not establish identity, link expiry or a confidentiality boundary.
sections.zh:
快速指南描述主办者登录仪表盘，即时开始或安排会话，然后发出邀请链接或房间号。活动房间队列是一种支持入口模式，不证明每位 Pro 客户已有配置好的网站队列。向客户提供前应测试目标进入路径。

FAQ 区分请求控制、当前主持者批准／拒绝，以及主办者收回控制。光标跟踪和跟随滚动提供视觉上下文，不等于同意别人操作账户。在订单示例中，应确定谁可导航、谁可提交更改，再用可丢弃数据验证交接。通过链接加入不证明身份、链接到期或保密边界。

sections.title_en: Redaction and authenticated access need an explicit configuration
sections.title_zh: 敏感遮挡与已登录访问需明确配置
sections.en:
The security page describes blocking selected elements and input fields, single-tab or new multi-tab sharing, and a multi-leader mode. The price table places sensitive-element redaction in Enterprise. Do not assume a Pro subscription includes every security control described on a general feature page.

The best-practices page says only the leader interacts with an authenticated site, whereas the security page also describes simultaneous leaders. Establish which mode your deployment uses and what each role can do. With synthetic secrets, inspect ordinary fields, validation messages, popups, newly opened tabs and any recording output. A hidden password field alone does not show that all related sensitive content is excluded. Switching to desktop sharing changes the exposure boundary and needs a separate check. No real credentials or account content were shared.
sections.zh:
安全页描述遮挡选定元素及输入框、单标签或新多标签共享，以及多主持者模式；价格表把敏感元素遮挡列在 Enterprise。不能假定 Pro 包含一般功能页所描述的全部安全控制。

最佳实践称已登录网站只有主持者能交互，安全页又描述同时存在多个主持者。应确认部署采用哪种模式，以及每种角色可做什么。用虚构秘密检查普通字段、验证消息、弹窗、新打开标签及录制输出；隐藏一个密码框，不证明所有相关敏感内容都被排除。切换桌面共享会改变暴露范围，需单独检查。本研究未共享真实凭据或账户内容。

sections.title_en: Integrated launch and short-lived access are engineering work
sections.title_zh: 集成启动及短期访问仍需工程实施
sections.en:
Enterprise integration describes launches through live chat, hotkeys or buttons, inside a new tab or iframe, and continuation from an authenticated page. A code-free end-user experience does not remove the work of configuring permissions, supported pages and the surrounding application.

The public API reference describes a limited-use token tied to a room, requiring a usage count of at least one and optionally an ISO8601 expiry/timezone. It separately describes public recording links with a validity duration in minutes. For a proposed support integration, bound the guest access and recording distribution separately. Check the returned success/error fields: documented errors include invalid JWT, invalid room and recording not found. A sample HTTP200 is not evidence that a particular operation succeeded. No token, room, recording link or authenticated API request was created.
sections.zh:
Enterprise 集成描述通过聊天、快捷键或按钮启动，在新标签或 iframe 中打开，并从已登录页面继续。终端用户免写代码，不会消除权限、支持页面及外围应用配置工作。

公开 API 参考描述绑定房间的受限使用令牌，要求使用次数至少为一，可选 ISO8601 到期时间／时区；另有按分钟设置有效期的公开录制链接。对于假设支持集成，应分别约束来宾访问与录制分发，检查返回的成功／错误字段；文档错误包含 JWT 无效、房间无效和找不到录制。示例 HTTP200 不证明某次操作成功。本研究未创建令牌、房间、录制链接或认证 API 请求。

sections.title_en: The official pages currently disagree on the Pro price
sections.title_zh: 官方页面对 Pro 价格存在分歧
sections.en:
The dedicated pricing page displays Pro at 40 USD/month; the homepage displays 50 USD/month. Both amounts were also visible in the actual browser and both Get Started links led to the same registration path. Retain the disagreement rather than selecting the cheaper number. The pricing page includes 10 GB storage and places integration, redaction, recording, white labeling and dedicated/self-hosted deployments under a custom Enterprise offer.

The monthly headline does not establish whether billing is per named host, concurrent session or another unit; the asterisk was not resolved. No current permanent-free entitlement, annual discount, tax, cancellation or renewal condition was confirmed. For budgeting, specify hosts, simultaneous rooms, storage, recording retention, integration and deployment requirements, then obtain the applicable amount and billing unit. No checkout or purchase was performed.
sections.zh:
独立价格页列 Pro 每月40美元，首页列每月50美元；实际浏览器也分别显示这两个金额，Get Started 都指向同一注册路径。应保留分歧，不能自行选较低数字。价格页包含10GB 存储，并把集成、敏感遮挡、录制、白标及专用／自行托管部署列为定制 Enterprise。

月价标题不能确立按实名主办者、并发会话或其他单位计费；星号条件未解决。本次未确认当前持续免费资格、年付折扣、税、取消或续订条件。预算应列明主办者、同时房间、存储、录制保留、集成及部署要求，再取得适用金额与计费单位。本研究未结账或购买。

sections.title_en: A rejoin path does not prove transaction recovery
sections.title_zh: 能重新加入不证明事务已恢复
sections.en:
The FAQ says a disconnected user rejoins as they initially entered. Best practices warns that answering a phone call on mobile can disconnect a session, recommends modern browsers and suggests download speeds of 8 Mbps or more for better results. These are vendor recommendations, not a measured minimum for every workload.

After a disruption in the proposed order workflow, verify the underlying order status before repeating an action. Reconnection alone does not show whether an earlier submission reached the website. The FAQ’s screen-sharing example of up to 100 viewers is explicitly an internal test dependent on machine, content and connection. It is not a universal contracted limit, nor evidence that virtually-unlimited cobrowse marketing applies to desktop broadcasting. Test the intended participant count and content; no latency, throughput or recovery benchmark was run.
sections.zh:
FAQ 称断线用户按首次进入方式重新加入。最佳实践提醒，移动端接听电话可能导致会话断开，建议现代浏览器，并称下载速度8Mbps 或以上体验较好。这是厂商建议，不是对所有工作负载实测出的最低要求。

假设订单流程断开后，应先核对底层订单状态，再重复操作；重连本身不表明先前提交是否到达网站。FAQ 所举最多100名屏幕共享观看者，明确来自依赖设备、内容及连接的内部测试；它不是统一合同上限，也不证明“几乎无限”的协同浏览宣传适用于桌面广播。应测试目标人数及内容；本研究未测量延迟、吞吐或恢复。

sections.title_en: Get a scoped retention and service agreement before production use
sections.title_zh: 生产使用前取得明确范围的保留及服务协议
sections.en:
The security page’s ephemeral-session claim is narrower than a complete retention policy: it separately describes analytics and uploaded cloud content. The combined policy generally specifies URL logging for 90 days with educational/enterprise exceptions, identifiers and stored message history. Do not describe the whole service as zero retention. Recording access, deletion, backup recovery and full export require their own answers.

The published license is limited, nontransferable and nonsublicensable, with modification/distribution restrictions and separate component-license exceptions. Its broad commercial-use restriction needs reconciliation with the Enterprise sales offer in the applicable written agreement; private deployment is not an open-source grant. This research does not settle that contractual conflict. Samesurf can be evaluated for guided web collaboration when the team can validate participant control and obtain the needed terms. It has not been established as a guaranteed compliance archive, universal website automation tool or consent-free way to act inside another person’s account.
sections.zh:
安全页的会话临时数据主张小于完整保留政策范围，且另外描述分析数据及上传云内容。组合政策一般规定 URL 日志保留90天，对教育／企业有例外，并描述标识符及消息历史存储。因此不能把整个服务描述为零留存。录制访问、删除、备份恢复及完整导出需分别确认。

公开许可有限、不可转让、不可再许可，限制修改分发，并保留单独组件许可例外。其宽泛商业使用限制，需在适用书面协议中与 Enterprise 销售方案澄清；私有部署不等于开源授权。本研究不裁定合同冲突。当团队可验证参与者控制并取得所需条款时，可评估 Samesurf 用于引导式网页协作；尚未确立其为保证合规的归档、通用网站自动化工具，或无需同意即可操作他人账户的方式。

seo.description_zh: 结合共享页面边界、邀请及主持控制、集成令牌、重连限制、保留范围及未解决计费条件评估 Samesurf。

secondary_questions: Does Pro include redaction or recording?
Does reconnecting confirm a website transaction succeeded?
